import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the iris dataset from a CSV file
iris_data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the data to transform it from wide to long format
iris_melted = pd.melt(iris_data, id_vars=['species'], var_name='feature', value_name='value')

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between features
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
g = sns.pairplot(iris_melted, hue='species', palette='viridis', markers=['o', 's', 'D'])

# Remove the axes from the diagonal subplots
for i, ax in enumerate(g.axs):
    ax.set_xticklabels([])
    ax.set_yticklabels([])
    if i == len(g.axs) - 1:
        ax.set_xlabel('')

# Set the title of the pairplot
plt.suptitle('Iris Flower Species Classification Dataset')

# Save the figure to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
